bib.title: 7 Named entity disambiguation (Knowledge Graphs and LLMs in Action)
bib.venue: book chapter, Knowledge Graphs and LLMs in Action (authors, publisher and year not printed in the chapter text)

question: How can named entity disambiguation against biomedical ontologies be combined with a knowledge graph to support search, interpretability and discovery over heterogeneous EU health documents?
contributions: Three-phase NED model (candidate selection, ranking, ontology integration) with scispaCy and UMLS
A KG schema and build pipeline (File, Page, EntityMention, MedicalEntity, SnomedEntity, HpoEntity, HpoDiseaseEntity, COOCCURR) in Neo4j
Four use cases: conceptual search, structured knowledge-based search, interpretability and discovery, uncovering new knowledge

limits: No gold labels or accuracy figure for NED; scispaCy output shown on one three-sentence passage.
ChatGPT test is a single informal prompt pair, version not stated; chapter notes responses vary.
Results vary slightly by environment, Neo4j indexing, ingestion order and scispaCy nondeterminism (7.7 note).
Co-occurrence counts are inflated by repeated bulletin headers (Communicable Diseases, 606); Table 7.1 to 7.9 are from one corpus.
Hub filtering threshold (350) and 3-hop Togavirus path are chosen by hand, no sensitivity shown.
Uncovering-new-knowledge uses co-occurrence only; relation extraction from text is mentioned as the stronger next step, not done.
practices: Link mentions to a reference knowledge base (NED) rather than stopping at NER when precision matters (7.1).
Keep both EntityMention and disambiguated MedicalEntity nodes in the graph for flexibility (7.6.3).
Use UMLS as the entry point and map SNOMED and HPO entities to it via UMLS IDs (7.6.4).
Propagate semantic types from SNOMED first-level nodes down SNOMED_IS_A to all descendants (7.6.4).
Collapse SNOMED's hundreds of relation types into one SNOMED_RELATION with a type property to keep the schema simple (7.6.4).
Store sentence index and character offsets of mentions so results can be debugged and shown in context (7.7.1).
Filter high-degree hub nodes (top 350 by GDS degree) before interpreting ontology paths (7.7.4).
Treat entity pairs that co-occur with no meaningful ontology path as candidate new knowledge (7.7.4).

terms.definition: automatically remove the uncertainty or ambiguity of the meaning of a mention by examining its context and connecting it to an entity in a knowledge base
a retrieval method that enables users to find information based on meaning rather than exact keywords
retrieves information in the text by using the formalized knowledge structured in the domain ontologies
the projection of Page nodes onto Entity nodes
